vivo has launched its all-new X500 Series in India, featuring the powerful vivo X500 Pro Max, X500 Pro and X500, along with the new vivo WATCH GT 2! 🔥

In this Reel, check out the **vivo X500 Pro Max Unboxing & First Look** — exploring its premium design, ZEISS cameras, telephoto photography, display, performance, battery and the latest vivo ecosystem! 👀📱

📸 200MP ZEISS APO Telephoto Camera
⚡ MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro
🎥 4K 240FPS Cinematic Slow-Motion Video
🔭 ZEISS Telephoto Extender Support
📺 2K ZEISS Master Color Display
🔋 Massive 7800mAh Battery
⚡ 90W Fast Charging
✨ Premium Tideline Design
⌚ New vivo WATCH GT 2
🚀 OriginOS 7 Experience

The **vivo X500 Pro Max** is bringing serious camera capabilities with advanced telephoto photography, motion tracking and cinematic video recording! 😳🔥

Also check out the vivo X500 Pro, vivo X500 and the new WATCH GT 2 for a complete look at vivo's latest flagship ecosystem! 💯
